commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
85' Here is a change. Mohammed Kudus is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Mathys Tel (Tottenham).
85' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jaidon Anthony.
84' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
84' Tottenham win a corner.
81' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is adjudged offside.
80' The substitution has been made. Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) has replaced Brennan Johnson.
80' Substitution. Lucas Bergvall makes his way off the pitch and Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) comes on as his replacement.
75' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
74' Scott Parker prepares a substitution. Oliver Sonne is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Burnley).
74' The referee signals a substitution. Zian Flemming (Burnley) is brought on as a substitute for Lyle Foster.
73' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
73' Now Burnley have a corner.
73' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) replacing Richarlison.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch so that Archie Gray can be given a rest.
70' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
66' 3 - 0 Goal Brennan Johnson (Tottenham)! Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) was put through by Pape Matar Sarr and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
64' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
63' Scott Parker has decided to substitute Hannibal Mejbri and he is replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Josh Laurent as he is replaced by Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley).
60' 2 - 0 What a GOAL! The lofted pass into the box is expertly and acrobatically dispatched into the net by Richarlison (Tottenham). 2:0.
58' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
57' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' The linesman signals that Lyle Foster (Burnley) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
52' Richarlison (Tottenham) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
52' The ball falls for Richarlison (Tottenham) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
49' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar.
49' The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
49' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Oliver starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A pass by Kyle Walker (Burnley) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
43' The corner from Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) is cleared away by the defence.
43' Guglielmo Vicario blocks Josh Laurent (Burnley)'s effort from the edge of the box. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
40' Djed Spence (Tottenham) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
39' Djed Spence (Tottenham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
36' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
35' Kyle Walker (Burnley) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
33' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty!
32' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Burnley earn a free kick.
30' Good chance! Josh Laurent (Burnley) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
29' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
28' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball.

27' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lyle Foster (Burnley). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
26' Lyle Foster (Burnley) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
24' Wasted opportunity! Kyle Walker (Burnley) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
23' Josh Laurent (Burnley) tested Guglielmo Vicario with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
21' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
18' The game is interrupted as Lyle Foster (Burnley) is flagged offside.
16' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
16' Oliver Sonne (Burnley) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
15' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
14' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
12' Richarlison (Tottenham) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!

10' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Richarlison (Tottenham) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom left corner. The assist goes to Mohammed Kudus and the score changes to 1:0.
9' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Lyle Foster (Burnley).
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Burnley, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Burnley have been awarded a free kick.
8' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
7' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
1' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. Tottenham have a corner.
1' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
